why: ChatGPT treated this as a single-device choice: a shortlist of rugged tablets (Galaxy Tab Active5 Pro, Dell Pro Rugged 12, Toughbook G2 MK3, Tab Active5), split by OS, IP rating, brightness and budget. It mentioned docks, hand straps and scanners only as optional extras, not as items the shopper must add. The deciding facts (Windows vs Android, IP65 vs IP68, 1,000-nit screen, hot-swap battery) pick one tablet, not a set, so a page comparing models such as Dealectric's Blackview Active 10 Pro and Active 8 Pro is the right fit.
